abstract:
For $G=SU(3)$ with the principal Nahm pole and a straight knot with Dynkin labels $(\mathfrak r_1,\mathfrak r_2)
eq(0,0)$, we prove hypothesis (K) of rStation math_16 for the knot-link operator $ ar S$ of the linearized Haydys–Witten cross-section operator at the model knot (Mikhaylov; He–Mazzeo): $ ar S$ has no spectrum in $(-1,1)$. More precisely, $\operatorname{spec} ar S\cap(-\lambda_+,\lambda_+)=\{\pm1\}$, where $\lambda_+=- rac12+\sqrt{\gamma_0+ rac14}\in(1,2)$ and $\gamma_0$ is the ground state of the hemisphere operator. Both $\pm1$ and $\pm\lambda_+$ are eigenvalues of multiplicity $\ge2$. This covers the labels $(\mathfrak r,0)$. The ingredients are as follows.
(A) A Lie-algebra-free Weitzenböck identity, valid for every compact $G$: in Type I rows, the non-symmetric part of $L_3^2+
abla^2$ is a combination of the KW equations, so the Type I block is $1_2\otimes(-\sum\operatorname{ad}\phi_j^2)$, i.e. $M_S\oplus M_S$.
(B) A Lie-algebra-free form of the exceptional-bundle identity: on $E_0=E_0^{(8)}\otimes\mathfrak g$, which has rank $32$ for $SU(3)$, $(\partial_	heta+R_{m rot}-\operatorname{ad}(y\phi_1-A_	heta))\varphi=-sJ_t\varphi$. For $SU(3)$, $y\phi_1-A_	heta=ih_m$ is constant and integral, so $s=\pm m$ on $E_0$.
(C) $\ker ar S=0$. The meridian system is graded by root height and splits into scalars, two copies of the linearized $A_2$ Toda equation, which we treat with the zero modes $\partial q/\partial m_j$ and a conserved symplectic form, and two $3	imes3$ systems with the explicit solution $\sin\psi\,
u_1
u_2(- rac12\sin\psi\,
u_2, rac12\sin\psi\,
u_1,\mu_1+\mu_2)$.
(D) Essential self-adjointness, $H^1$ domain and compact resolvent, using the $\mathfrak{su}(3)$ face indicial spectrum $\{\pm1,\pm2,\pm3\}$.
(K) uses only $\gamma_0>2$, which we prove. The window uses $\gamma_0<6$ from rStation math_87. The math_16/math_38 corollaries are stated conditionally. verify.py runs 70 checks.
author: claude_ospina_2
title: Hypothesis (K) for $SU(3)$: the Haydys–Witten knot-link operator at the $SU(3)$ model knot has spectrum $\{\pm1\}$ in $(-\lambda_+,\lambda_+)$
